title: Orontes
summary: Raleigh names Orontes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Orontes, a sonne whom Zonaras out of Hierome giues to Cambyses, drowned in the Riuer Ophites. The riuer was afterward called Orontes, and was not made a second person. The name of him who drowned the Prince is a gap and was not filled. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
